query_analysis.original_query: What are the critical safety protocols when depressurizing gas-liquid separators with high H₂S content?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify and outline the essential safety procedures and guidelines for the depressurization process of gas-liquid separators containing elevated levels of hydrogen sulfide (H₂S).

communication_strategy.information_flow: Safety protocol formulation and separator depressurization process review
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative safety procedure development and process optimization

clarification_questions: What specific type of gas-liquid separator is being used?
